attr.title: GPort2X: Payback (GP2X)
attr.desc: A GP2X user-mode compatibility layer that runs Payback from your own GP2X SD card image, with your own GP2X firmware, read-only and frame-identical to the original's behaviour. Launch the game directly or boot the GP2X menu.
attr.inst: Copy your GP2X firmware dump (the root filesystem: bin, lib, usr/gp2x, ...) into ports/gport2x/firmware/ and your Payback SD card image (.img) into ports/gport2x/card/. Nothing from either is included.
